banners.prompt:
This input photo shows the woman who is the main character of a vertical smartphone video. Create a NEW still frame of the SAME woman for one scene of that video (it will be the starting frame that an AI video model animates; keep her pose simple, hands already in their final position).

IDENTITY (critical): it must be unmistakably the same woman: identical face, facial features, age, skin tone and texture, eye colour, hair colour, length and hairstyle, same clothes and accessories (and glasses if she wears them). Do not beautify or rejuvenate her.
SETTING: the same living room as in the input photo in the evening: the sofa, warm floor lamp, the shelf with family photos and children's drawings. Keep the same place, light and mood.
PHOTO STYLE (critical): a real, unedited smartphone photo, like a still from an Instagram story. Natural light, natural colours, real skin texture, slight phone-camera noise, normal phone depth of field. NOT glossy, NOT retouched, NOT cinematic, NOT stock, no beauty filter, no studio light, no heavy background blur, no HDR.
FRAMING: vertical 9:16, phone on a small stand at eye level, she looks into the lens. Medium close-up, head and upper body.
The image has plain bars along two edges purely as padding: fill the whole frame naturally, no bars, no borders.
Do not add any captions, labels, logos, watermarks or readable text anywhere, except the book cover when a book is shown.

SCENE: She sits on the sofa. She holds TWO things side by side at chest height, both clearly and fully visible in the frame: in her left hand a tablet turned towards the camera with a bright glowing colourful game screen (cartoon colours, no readable content), and in her right hand the gift-wrapped book. She is lifting the book slightly higher than the tablet, as if choosing the book, front cover facing the camera. She looks straight into the camera with a warm, knowing smile. The attached second image is the book. When the book is visible, its FRONT cover must be reproduced exactly and accurately from that image (cream hardcover with a thin gold frame line, large dark serif title 'Просто нарисувай!', subtitle 'Практически наръчник за рисуване', pencil drawings of a cat on an open sketchbook with a hand holding a pencil, flowers, small birds, cubes, spheres and a fox, author name 'Мартин Василев' at the bottom and a small round black seal), on a real hardcover book matching the perspective in her hands. Copy every Cyrillic letter exactly; do not invent or change any letter. The book is closed. GIFT WRAP: a strip of brown kraft paper is wrapped around the middle of the book and tied with natural jute twine in a bow on the front (exactly like a small handmade gift); the title at the top and the author at the bottom stay visible.
